pages.title: A Particular Teapot
pages.text: Learn a teapot with its own fluid-and-ingredient sequence.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: First add the supported full fluid portion, then the recipe ingredient. The processing pot cannot be picked up; extra fluid and the wrong order are rejected.

pages.title: Prepare a teapot in the right order
pages.text: The small Teapot has stages: first an allowed fluid portion, then an ingredient and processing. The whole pot cannot be retrieved while cooking.
